messages:
mira: spotted funky p95 swings on /v1/infer in the latency dashboard — p50 steady, p95 toggles between ~180ms and ~720ms depending on the pane window. img: https://dash.redwood/internal/infer_p95_spike.png

sam: which window size? 5m rolling vs 1h? sounds like a small-subgroup tail driving the merged percentile.

mira: 5m shows the jump, 1h smooths it. quick export: overall p95=200ms (n=420), primary p95=190ms (n=410), quota-fallback p95=730ms (n=10).

sam: yep that explains it. fallback n=10 but huge tail — our merged approx_percentile has no visibility into subgroup counts. oncall gets paged and it's a red herring.

lee: short-term UI fix: add a small `# samples` pill next to each percentile line and a low-confidence state when subgroup_n < 30. long-term: migrate to t-digest/sketches and expose merge_error_pct.

mira: UX idea: pill shows `n=10` and an inline `~err=20%` when available, plus a tiny "split by policy" CTA to immediately show primary vs fallback lines.

ops-bot: rollout/weight-change service=infer route=quota-fallback old=0.01 new=0.15 user=sam at=2025-03-15T12:23:01Z

sam: backend work: add `?include=percentile_meta` to telemetry API returning flat arrays: tags[], counts[], errors[]. keep it shallow to avoid huge payloads.

lee: also add a cap on returned groups (e.g., top 50 by count) and include a truncation flag so console can surface "+12 more groups". don't return nested objects — flat arrays only for now.

sam: security note: ensure tag values are sanitized (no long freeform strings). we'll enforce max length 64 and a hash fallback.

mira: I'll open ENGPLAT-1499 (console pill + split CTA) and ENGPLAT-1500 (telemetry meta API + caps). will prototype the pill first so oncall stops chasing phantom p95s.

lee: one more: annotate the latency charts with ops-bot rollout/deploy events automatically. that single annotation often saves 30m of triage time.

mira: agreed. will add to the ticket. monitoring plan: watch p95 for 4h after UI patch; if we still see surprise flips we'll fast-track t-digest migration tests. :thumbsup:
